file_editor.title: File Editor
file_editor.subtitle: Every plugin file in one place: edit overlay and local plugins, browse the rest
file_editor.active_save_hint: Expand Active Save in the tree to browse this playthrough's per-save bios; select one to edit it or copy it into a plugin.
file_editor.empty_editor: Select a file to view or edit
file_editor.plugin_read_only: This layer is read-only, so its details can't be edited here.
file_editor.folder_selected: {{name}}: pick a file to edit, or use the chevron to expand this folder.
file_editor.winner_tip: Winning: this is the active copy
file_editor.shadowed_tip: Shadowed: a higher-priority copy is active
file_editor.copy_to_overlay_banner: This file belongs to {{layer}} and is read-only. Copy it into your Overlay to edit; the plugin's copy stays underneath for one-click revert.
file_editor.import_banner: This file is in the plugin folder but not tracked in install.json. Import it to edit it here, publish it, and remove it on uninstall.
file_editor.import_all_hint: {{count}} file(s) in this plugin's folder aren't tracked in install.json yet.
file_editor.new_file_hint: Pick a type and name. It lands in the selected folder, the selected plugin's folder for that type, or the Overlay.
file_editor.new_plugin_hint: Name the plugin and its author. It starts empty at the top of the load order; fill in the rest by selecting it.
file_editor.plugin_name_invalid: That title and author can't form a plugin id; use letters or numbers.
file_editor.new_folder_hint: Name a content root: prompts, triggers, actions or knowledge.
file_editor.folder_err_root: Top-level folders must be a content root: prompts, triggers, actions or knowledge.
file_editor.folder_err_charset: Folder names can use letters, numbers, and . _ - only.
file_editor.folder_err_one_level: Create one folder at a time; names can't contain a slash.
file_editor.rename_invalid: Use letters, numbers, and . _ - only, no spaces.
file_editor.rename_exists: A file named {{name}} already exists here.
file_editor.paste_not_editable: Paste into an editable layer: the Overlay or a local plugin.
file_editor.paste_cross_root: A file can only be placed under its own content root ({{root}}).
file_editor.delete_msg: Delete {{name}} from {{layer}}? This can't be undone.
file_editor.transfer_copy_only: {{name}} is read-only, so it will be copied.
file_editor.gui_no_item: No matching item found for this file.
file_editor.gui_no_entries: This pack has no entries yet.
file_editor.entry_delete_confirm: Delete entry {{name}}? This can't be undone.
file_editor.entry_no_key: This entry has no key (an older pack format), so it can't be edited here. Re-export the pack to add keys.
